output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This divides total 2025 net revenue by the number of distinct customers with at least one revenue-counting order dated in 2025. Only orders flagged is_revenue are included, so a customer whose 2025 orders were all non-revenue is not counted as having bought something. Shipping fees are not added, since the measure used is net_revenue.
